boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Kings Point ceremonies, objects, and recurring observances rooted in the Regiment of Midshipmen.

cards.title: Take the Honor Oath seriously
cards.subtitle: A Regiment-wide commitment
cards.notes: Read the Academy’s one-sentence Honor Code before visiting or talking with a midshipman; it frames the oath and the peer-led Honor Board process.
cards.short_summary: The Academy documents an oath binding midshipmen to its Honor Code in all settings.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA says incoming midshipmen sign an Honor Oath and that the Honor Code is “A Midshipman will not lie, cheat, or steal.”
cards.source_title: Honor Board | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: An internal regimental practice; observe Academy visitor and event rules.

cards.title: Spot the Honor Coin
cards.subtitle: A reminder issued during honor education
cards.notes: Look for official Honor Coin imagery in Academy materials; its two sides connect the Honor Code with the Academy’s stated values and memorialize Aaron Seesan ’03.
cards.short_summary: Plebe candidates have received a coin as a tangible reminder of the Academy’s Honor Code.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA reports that plebe candidates received an Honor Coin after their Honor Oath, and identifies its Honor Code and core-values inscriptions.
cards.source_title: USMMA Plebe Candidates Take Honor Oath | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: The coin is associated with Academy honor education; do not assume public distribution.

cards.title: Notice the “142” on the Battle Standard
cards.subtitle: The only federal service academy battle standard
cards.notes: When the color guard appears, look for the red, white, and blue standard and its “142,” a visual memorial to Academy cadet-midshipmen lost in World War II.
cards.short_summary: The Battle Standard is a distinct Academy color-guard object carrying a WWII memorial.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA says it is the only federal service academy authorized to carry a battle standard and that its “142” commemorates Academy cadet-midshipmen who died in World War II.
cards.source_title: Battle Standard | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: View it only at public Academy ceremonies or through official materials.

cards.title: Follow the formal Battle Standard toasts
cards.subtitle: Annual senior-class memorial dinner
cards.notes: If invited to an Academy observance, follow the program rather than improvising: formal toasts honor the Nation, Commander in Chief, fallen comrades, and USMMA.
cards.short_summary: A formal annual dinner has the senior class lead traditional toasts while honoring fallen Kings Pointers.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA’s 2026 report calls the Battle Standard Dinner its 37th annual event and documents the four traditional formal toasts.
cards.source_title: USMMA Hosts 37th Annual Battle Standard Dinner | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: A formal Academy event; attendance depends on an invitation or official event access.

cards.title: Listen for the Powell Oval bell
cards.subtitle: License-exam milestone at Powell Oval
cards.notes: Watch official Academy channels around Coast Guard license-exam results; the graduating class rings the bell at Powell Oval only after passing those examinations.
cards.short_summary: Bell-ringing marks the class’s passage of Coast Guard license examinations.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA announced that members of the Class of 2026 would ring the bell at Powell Oval after passing U.S. Coast Guard license exams.
cards.access_notes: Timing follows release of license-exam results; check official Academy announcements.

cards.title: See plebe candidates become plebes
cards.subtitle: Oath-and-parade transition into the Regiment
cards.notes: Use the Academy calendar or Parents Weekend information for public details; Acceptance Day centers on the Corps of Cadets Oath and the new class’s formal transition.
cards.short_summary: Acceptance Day changes status from plebe candidate to plebe and brings the class into the Regiment.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA states that Acceptance Day marks the transition from “plebe candidates” to “plebes,” with the Academy oath administered during the ceremony and parade.
cards.source_title: 237 Plebes Join the Regiment of Midshipmen and U.S. Navy Reserve During Acceptance Day Ceremony | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: Ceremony access and dates vary; rely on current Academy event guidance.

cards.title: Recognize the Regimental Thanksgiving table
cards.subtitle: Annual Delano Hall gathering
cards.notes: If you attend as an authorized guest, follow the dining-hall program and notice the family-style meal, which brings the Regiment and returning sea-year midshipmen together.
cards.short_summary: The Academy’s annual Thanksgiving observance centers on a Regiment-wide dinner in Delano Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA describes the Regimental Thanksgiving Dinner in Delano Hall as an annual, time-honored Academy tradition.
cards.source_title: USMMA Celebrates Thanksgiving and Holds Change of Command Ceremony | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: Delano Hall meals are for midshipmen and authorized guests; do not assume public entry.

cards.title: Watch the Regiment hand over command
cards.subtitle: Leadership rotation ceremony
cards.notes: Look for official coverage around the Thanksgiving observance; the ceremony formally transfers regimental leadership roles, making the change visible rather than merely administrative.
cards.short_summary: A formal ceremony follows the Thanksgiving observance to transfer regimental command.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA reports that its Commandant’s Department hosted a Regimental Change of Command Ceremony following the annual Thanksgiving observance.
cards.source_title: USMMA Celebrates Thanksgiving and Holds Change of Command Ceremony | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: This is a regimental ceremony; access depends on Academy event rules.

cards.title: Experience the Festival of Lights
cards.subtitle: Interfaith Chapel tradition
cards.notes: Check the Academy’s December announcements for attendance details; the service brings music, readings, and an interfaith Hanukkah-and-Christmas observance to the Mariners’ Memorial Chapel.
cards.short_summary: The Academy’s Festival of Lights is a long-running interfaith year-end service.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA reported that its 2025 Festival of Lights was in its 48th year and included an interfaith celebration of Hanukkah and Christmas.
cards.source_title: Festival of Light and Celebration at Kings Point | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: Confirm public access, date, and chapel procedures through the Academy before attending.

cards.title: Follow the Secretaries’ Cup rivalry
cards.subtitle: USMMA versus Coast Guard football
cards.notes: Check the current Academy calendar for the host site and kickoff; this annual matchup pairs the Mariners with the Coast Guard Academy in a named federal-academy rivalry.
cards.short_summary: The Secretaries’ Cup is the Academy’s recurring football rivalry with the Coast Guard Academy.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA describes the Secretaries’ Cup as a longstanding annual football matchup between USMMA and the U.S. Coast Guard Academy.
cards.source_title: Fenway Park to Host 2025 Secretaries’ Cup | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: The 2026 Academy calendar lists the game for November 14; location is to be announced.
